notes.title: nightshift On-hold
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40882256/30670e69a7abbbb9246d82689f6149a227d8acee.png[/img]



I’m writing to inform you that nightshift update is behind schedule. I apologize for the delay.
Due to starting College, this project update has been delayed by 2023.

In order to address these unforeseen circumstances, I have stopped all projects moving forward

Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any questions about the delay, and the project completion date, or any other details related to the project.
Sincerely,





Eric Adams
